description:
About Us

Gumloop is the multiplayer AI agent builder. We believe the people who know the work best should be able to automate it, and use what they build to help their whole team do more.



Anyone at a company can build, share, and optimize agents with any AI model and any integration. Teams can orchestrate those agents across their business, while IT keeps full control over data, access, and spend.



We're a small team building as fast as humanly possible. Gusto, Ramp, Shopify, Samsara, Instacart, and Opendoor are running agents on Gumloop across their company. We've raised over $70M https://www.gumloop.com/blog/series-b from Benchmark, First Round Capital, Y Combinator, Nexus Ventures to scale and are looking for people who care as much as we do to join the team.



Here’s what life at Gumloop is like:

 - Our beliefs – The Handbook https://www.gumloop.com/handbook

 - Our adventures – Wall of Photos https://www.gumloop.com/photos

 - What our users are saying - Wall of Love https://www.gumloop.com/love

 - What we’re working on – Changelog https://www.gumloop.com/changelog
   
   



Role Overview

We're looking for an Infrastructure Engineer to own and scale the systems that power Gumloop. You'll architect and roll out large scale infrastructure projects independently, help define our technical roadmap, and work directly with the founders to improve reliability, security, and performance.


Our current focus areas include infrastructure for agent orchestration, agent sandboxing, and hosted MCP services. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to solve challenging infrastructure problems at a company at the edge of AI.

What You'll Do

 - Architect, implement, and roll out large-scale infrastructure projects independently

 - Build and scale infrastructure supporting agent orchestration, agent sandboxing, and hosted MCP services

 - Help define the technical roadmap and speak directly with customers to inform priorities

 - Work directly with the founders to improve the reliability and scalability of our infrastructure

 - Design and maintain Kubernetes clusters, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure on GCP

 - Ensure high availability, security, observability, and performance across our systems

What You Bring

 - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Redis, GCP, Terraform, Prometheus, and CI/CD

 - A track record of owning infrastructure at scale in a fast-moving environment

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to own projects from architecture through production

 - Comfort working in a small team where ownership, autonomy, and speed are expected

 - Strong communication skills, including the ability to speak with customers and collaborate directly with founders

Bonus

 - Experience at a high-growth startup scaling infrastructure rapidly

 - Exposure to AI/ML infrastructure and model serving

 - Experience with agent orchestration, sandboxing, MCP, or related distributed systems


BENEFITS

 - Highly competitive salary and meaningful equity

 - Generous paid time off: 24 days for SF employees and 20 days globally, use them as you need

 - $350/month wellness benefit to spend on gym, spa, equipment, or whatever keeps you at your best

 - 15 days of temporary remote work flexibility per year

 - 401k match up to 6%
